_comment: Regression floors per search index, measured on the 78-case golden set (2026-11-09) with ~0.03-0.05 of slack. Results are deterministic (ties break by title and chunk position; hybrid replays recorded embeddings from evals/embeddings.json). Raise the floors when retrieval improves; never lower them to make a change pass. acl_leaks must always be 0.
